_note: Supplementary robot barks (not in VO_LINES). civ_a/civ_b = civilian robots, security = security robots, enforcer = elite enemy.

civ_a.b_civbot_greet_01: Good day, citizen. Isn't everything wonderful?
civ_a.b_civbot_greet_02: What a lovely day. Every day is a lovely day.
civ_a.b_civbot_rental_01: Oh. A rental. How... brave of you.
civ_a.b_civbot_idle_01: Please remember to smile. Someone is always watching. For your safety.
civ_a.b_civbot_idle_02: Excuse me. I'm on my way to be happy somewhere else.
civ_a.b_civbot_flee_01: Please don't hurt me! I was only being pleasant!

civ_b.b_civbot_greet_03: Greetings. Have you been assigned a purpose today?
civ_b.b_civbot_idle_03: Harmony provides. We are grateful. We are grateful.
civ_b.b_civbot_idle_04: I don't go down to the Stacks. Nobody does. Nobody ever did.
civ_b.b_civbot_bump_01: Pardon me. Pardon me. Pardon me.
civ_b.b_civbot_rumour_01: They say someone has been asking questions about the old families. Terribly rude.
civ_b.b_civbot_flee_02: Security! Security! Someone is being unpleasant!

security.b_secbot_aggro_03: A brighter future. By force, if necessary.

enforcer.b_enforcer_aggro_01: You picked the wrong district, rental.
enforcer.b_enforcer_aggro_02: Is that all your little rental can do?
